Blue Comet, case log.

If the base is a wreck when you read this, they found it. The suit stays in its case. It is not for sale and it is not a trophy.

Red Sentinel, last report.

They came through the east wall at dawn. I held the line long enough for the city to sleep through it. That is the job.

Green Warden, field log.

The tower fell, I did not. Moving on. Whoever finds this: the vault opens for anyone with a good heart and a strong arm.
Crashed tech turns up everywhere now: drone wrecks, meteors that glow, pods from Apokolips. Strip them for Salvaged Tech. Four pieces and an iron ingot make Hero Alloy.
The crews leave trails. A Locator from a cache points at their Sites; the Sites point at their Hideouts. Follow it up, one rung at a time.
Watch the cliffs for smugglers and the rooftops in the City for my old friends' stashes. Take what you need. Leave the rest for the next one.
projecthero.guide.loot.places.body: Rarer than the finds above, bigger and more detailed, each in two or three layouts. Every one holds a Hero Cache plus a themed container of its own, and several often hand out a Site Locator. No alarms: a few have a couple of guards, most have none.
projecthero.guide.loot.place.ruined_hero: Ruined Hero Base: a wrecked hideout (concrete, brick warehouse or toppled tower) with the hero's suit still in its smashed glass case, case notes on a lectern and a locker. Forests, plains, hills, jungles.
projecthero.guide.loot.place.crashed_par: Crashed Parademon Pod: a scorched crater with an Apokolips drop pod, its hatch blown off and a tech cache inside. Two Parademons still guard it. Deserts, badlands, savannas, plains.
projecthero.guide.loot.place.abandoned_w: Abandoned Workshop: a dusty inventor's lab (barn, garage or copper-roofed lab) with a broken suit frame on chains and a parts bin that always holds Salvaged Tech. Forests, taiga, plains.
projecthero.guide.loot.place.smugglers_d: Smugglers' Den: a cave stash dug into a cliff, hidden behind vines, a waterfall or the boards of an old mine. Three Syndicate smugglers and a chest of contraband. Look along steep hillsides.
projecthero.guide.loot.place.rooftop_sta: Rooftop Vigilante Stash: a lean-to, radio post or shack on the flat roof of a City building, left by a street-level hero. Only in Cities, one or two per City.
projecthero.guide.loot.place.tech_meteor: Tech Meteor: a small crater around a glowing lump of alien rock bristling with crystals, scrap strewn round it. The vault sits in a cleft in the meteor. Anywhere on land.
projecthero.guide.structures.places.body: Besides these, the Overworld is dotted with smaller places to loot: crashed drones and pods, tech meteors, hidden caches, ruined hero bases, abandoned workshops, smugglers' dens and rooftop stashes in the City. See the Loot & Progression chapter.
